DuckDB works with Delta tables through its `delta` extension, from SQL or
Python.

## Set it up

- [Build a Delta table in Python and query it with DuckDB](../../tutorials/python-to-duckdb/index.md)

## Journeys

Open a group to see each journey and the example that runs it.
